unpartitioned_bundles: The atlas matrix row 'Carry/panel/HTF/weekly' is a single bundled row covering four distinct objects. All four inherit the bundle's cell values verbatim; per-object mass is UNPARTITIONED and must not be read as measured per object.

measurement_layer.note: A sha-only Contract that matches no sealed instance's CONTENT resolves to nothing and is counted as named, never as executed. One that DOES match is resolved to the id it names (recorded in findings_contract_resolved_by_content_hash); resolution is still not execution.

terminus_census.note: Tokens are EXTRACTED from the decision text, never invented. They name the programme a pre-registry decision belongs to; no H-* exists for them.

session_log_marker_forms.note: rotate_session_log.py:_MARKER_RE recognises only the emoji / '??' forms; the bare form is invisible to it. Reported, not fixed (separate authorized turn). `unparsed` is the shortfall between a loose marker scan and strict entry parsing - reported so any dropped decision is visible, never silently absorbed.
